items.title: AI staff 'genuinely frightened' for humanity's future, ex-Anthropic researcher tells BBC
items.description: It comes as the AI firm's boss has called for the technology's development to be slowed down, citing "serious" risks.

items.title: Russia struck train near Poland border shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials passed through
